bed.table_first.help: make and place a crafting table before crafting a bed

brain.death_avoid.help: options that clearly kill us in this context (every game's deaths) go behind the safe ones

brain.death_s.help: what a death costs in the strategist's sums, in seconds (the kit is lost)

brain.skill_stats.help: options that clearly fail here (learned skill stats) go behind the ones that work

brain.strategist.help: pick late-game routes (portal, rods, pearls, stronghold, End) by learned expected time

brain.thompson.help: the strategist costs routes with a success chance drawn from its uncertainty (explores thinly tried routes)

brain.utility.help: every goal's items go through the strategist (cheapest route by measured cost), not only the late game's

cave.seal_openings.help: close newly mined cave mouths during iron and coal trips before walking into exposed mobs

cave.torch_light.help: place a torch when block light at our feet is at or below this

cave.torch_recipe.help: hand craft torches when the recipe book has not unlocked them before a mine trip

cave.torches.help: place a torch wherever it's dark underground (mobs spawn only in the dark)

combat.backstep.help: step back out of reach while the sword recharges

combat.commit_target.help: while fighting a mob in reach, reflexes may pull us out but not switch us to another fight

combat.creeper_gap.help: distance to regain after hitting a creeper

combat.creeper_hit.help: hit a visible creeper once, then back off before its fuse completes

combat.creeper_priority_range.help: range for preferring a creeper among several visible hostiles

combat.crits.help: jump before a swing so it lands as a critical hit (1.5x)

combat.deflect.help: hit a ghast's fireball back when it comes close

combat.finish_heal_wall.help: let shelter finish placing its healing wall before routine melee reflexes

combat.flee_hp.help: at or below this health, run when outnumbered (reflex and planner share it)

combat.ignore_walled_mobs.help: a close mob we failed to reach, can't see and that isn't hurting us is left alone for a minute

combat.keep_dist.help: backstep inside this distance while a melee weapon recharges

combat.no_close_retreat.help: fight or wall in within four blocks; keep retreating from nearby creepers

combat.outnumbered.help: hostiles within 6 blocks that count as outnumbered

combat.shield_guard.help: raise the shield toward a skeleton drawing its bow or a creeper about to blow

combat.skeleton_approach.help: zig-zag toward a visible skeleton, guarding with an off-hand shield

combat.skeleton_zigzag.help: ticks between direction changes during skeleton approach

combat.sprint_hit.help: sprint into the first melee hit for knockback

combat.sprint_hit_dist.help: distance at which the first sprint hit begins

combat.strafe.help: ticks between side-step direction changes while recharging; zero disables

combat.swing_at.help: attack cooldown fraction required before a melee swing

combat.target_rule.help: target nearest, most previously hit, or a nearby creeper first

combat.wall_in_anywhere.help: hurt and outnumbered: wall in and heal on the surface too, instead of running

combat.zombie_pack.help: keep space and answer the closest zombie in a pack; leave drops until the pack is gone

death.recover_night_armor.help: go back for dropped items at night only with this much armor

death.recover_value.help: go back for dropped items only when they're worth it (iron-tier+) and health 12+ or food

death.trip_commit.help: keep going for dropped items past routine fights; respond to close or multiple mobs

deep.branch.help: diamond_hunt uses spaced 1x2 tunnels at -58, taking visible veins and backing away from fluids and caves

deep.food.help: cooked food to carry before going down for diamonds

deep.mold.help: obsidian_pool: nothing safe to mine, so make obsidian a block at a time in a dug pit (two buckets)

deep.stairs.help: diamond_hunt goes down by safe 1-wide stairs first (slow: 12 of 24 min in a trial) instead of collect's own descent

deep.sticks.help: sticks to carry down for the diamond pickaxe (torches use them too)

dragon.eat_hp.help: in the End fight, eat at or below this health while it flies

dragon.max_center_dist.help: in the End fight, walk back if farther than this from the fountain

dragon.wait_dist.help: where to wait while the dragon flies: this far from the fountain

fluid.enclosed_tunnel.help: drain only flooded passages with a solid roof and walls, not open lakes

focus.commit.help: finish the running task before switching, unless the top option is an emergency

food.early_stock.help: stock eight cooked meals before the first iron trip

food.eat_at.help: eat at or below this hunger

food.eat_hurt_at.help: eat at or below this hunger when health isn't full

food.hunt_dist.help: hunt animals in view within this distance for the stock

food.keep_full.help: eat carried food below 18 hunger so health can regenerate

food.search_hunger.help: explore far for animals only at or below this hunger

food.stock.help: cooked food to keep in stock

gather.cautious_depth.help: without armor mine iron no deeper than y 40 (y 48 after a deep death); armor 10+ uses gather.iron_y

gather.coal_upkeep_below.help: grab coal in view while carrying fewer than this

gather.coal_view_dist.help: coal (and iron) ore this close counts as in view

gather.dry_stone.help: prefer only seen stone with no water touching it

gather.first_logs.help: extra logs on the very first wood trip

gather.iron_in_view.help: take iron ore in view while the route still needs iron

gather.iron_y.help: height to branch-mine iron at (16: most ore, most caves)

gather.log_stock.help: keep this many logs once there is a pickaxe

gather.stair_for_stone.help: when no dry seen stone is near, reach stone by safe stairs from dry ground

gather.stone_extra.help: extra stone per trip while short of the stock

gather.stone_stock.help: stone stock the extra fills toward

gather.vein_follow.help: after breaking a seen block, take a visible block of the same kind touching it first (follow the vein)

gear.armor_first.help: after the iron pickaxe, make chestplate, sword, helmet and boots before portal work

gear.shield_early.help: craft and equip a shield after the first iron ingot

gear.sword_early.help: craft a sword matching the pickaxe's tier as soon as possible

inv.tidy.help: toss junk stacks (andesite, spare stone past 128) when fewer than 4 slots are free

learned.explore.help: chance to try a non-first option (data for learning)

learned.weight.help: 0 = rules order only; higher trusts the learned model more

loop.lost_underground_s.help: seconds underground with nothing gained before heading up

loop.stuck_s.help: seconds without moving that mark the state as stuck for the brains

mine.tread_water.help: breaking a block while floating in water: hold jump to stay level instead of sinking away from it

move.shore_first.help: reach seen dry ground before ground work or exploring from water

nav.fluid_place.help: let Baritone lay blocks across water and lava, and sprint-swim

nav.mob_avoid_coef.help: how much Baritone's paths avoid monsters (1 = not at all)

nav.mob_avoid_radius.help: radius around monsters that paths avoid

nav.surface_v2.help: goto surface: judge Baritone by height gained, fall back to digging a staircase up

nav.unstuck_v2.help: unstuck: climb a staircase first in a pit or under a roof, and before tunnelling

nether.pie_chart.help: look for a fortress where the F3 pie chart shows spawners, like speedrunners (pie-ray)

night.mine_instead.help: at night, skip the shelter when the next step is mining underground anyway

night.no_shaft_wall.help: wall in on safe footing when no nearby shelter shaft can be dug

night.shelter_armor.help: at night on the surface, shelter if armor is below this

night.shelter_exit.help: at morning, climb out of the covered shelter shaft by stairs before moving on

night.shelter_max_s.help: longest wait in a night shelter before going back to work

night.shelter_radius.help: shelter only with a hostile within this radius

night.wall_in.help: at night, wall in on the spot (fast) instead of digging a shelter hole

pearls.barter_ingots.help: gold ingots to gather and trade before hunting endermen for the rest

pearls.boat_trap.help: trap endermen in a boat before killing them (they can't teleport or hit back)

pearls.provoke_s.help: seconds to wait for a stared-at enderman to come into the boat

pearls.target.help: ender pearls to collect (14 eyes: 2-3 to triangulate, 12 for the frames)

plan.hide_hp.help: underground, wall in at or below this health with 2+ monsters near

plan.hostile_range.help: hostiles within this range get an urgent option

plan.livelock_break.help: a minute of actions with no movement, item or kill is a loop: leave those mobs, pause those actions

plan.noop_success_pause.help: pause an action after three successes that changed neither inventory nor position

plan.readiness.help: check the kit before a one-way door (Nether, End) and get what's missing first

plan.upkeep_calm_radius.help: no upkeep while a hostile is within this radius

portal.carve_search.help: underground, look for a carvable portal room within 6 blocks, not only at our feet

portal.prepare_work_area.help: prepare a dry floor for the portal frame when no natural site fits

portal.reserve_lava_bucket.help: retired 2026-09-29 (always on: two water buckets deadlocked the cast); kept so old genomes load

portal.retry_cast_view.help: after losing the bucket view, try a different stand for the same frame block

portal.site_maker.help: dig a visible portal room and repair its floor when natural flat ground is absent

ready.end_blocks.help: throwaway blocks to carry into the End

ready.end_food.help: food to carry into the End

ready.nether_blocks.help: throwaway blocks to carry into the Nether

ready.nether_food.help: food to carry into the Nether

reflex.burning_hp.help: eat while burning at or below this health

reflex.clutch_fall.help: falling farther than this with a water bucket: pour it before landing

reflex.creeper_dist.help: back off from a creeper closer than this

reflex.escalate.help: fled the same way twice in 30 s: stand and fight or wall in instead of running again

reflex.lava_margin.help: step away from lava right beside us

reflex.melee_dist.help: a hostile this close triggers the fight/flee reflex

reflex.starving_food.help: eat at once at or below this hunger when safe

restock.stash_only.help: restock only after death from a chest we actually stashed spares into

route.armor_before_portal.help: chestplate and helmet before the portal

route.barter.help: get pearls by trading gold with piglins before hunting endermen

route.bed.help: hunt sheep and make a bed early

route.boots_before_portal.help: boots too when 4 ingots are spare

route.deep_for_lava.help: mine down to lava depth instead of exploring for a pool

route.deep_portal.help: the diamond route as one plan: kit up top, diamonds and a lava pool at depth, frame built in a dug room

route.diamond_portal.help: portal the classic way (diamond pickaxe, mine 10 obsidian) instead of casting it

safety.enderman_gaze.help: never meet an enderman's eyes (any dimension); fight back when one is angry

safety.hazard.help: the learned danger model may swap a pick (emergencies too) for a clearly safer option

safety.hazard_margin.help: how much lower the death risk must be to swap (0.1 = 10 points)

safety.spawner_break.help: at a live overworld spawner in reach, break it (pickaxe, 12+ hp) instead of walling off and leaving

safety.spawner_room.help: wall off an active overworld spawner and avoid death drops and chests near it

skill.barter_loop.help: gold on, then barter round after round until the pearls are in

skill.bed_bomb.help: blow up beds at the perched dragon's head (beds explode in the End)

skill.blaze_farm.help: hold a 3-sided nook at the spawner, hit blazes at the opening, seal to heal

insights: An urgent planner option that a reflex will cancel right away does harm. It breaks off the current fight, so planner conditions must match the reflex thresholds such as reflex.melee_dist.

A skill's refusal checks must accept everything its reflex caller can hand it (reflex.melee_dist vs a hardcoded 4-block cutoff), or the reflex starts a skill that fails at once while the threat stays on us.
A progress detector keyed only on position punishes skills whose real progress is gathering items in place; check the skill's actual output before declaring stuck.
build_portal NO_ROOM failed instantly on retries because the carve fallback only tested a single room layout anchored at the bot's feet, and next to a lava pool that layout always touches the lava.

At the ocean the remembered water sources had no dry bank, so fill_bucket failed NOT_FOUND while explore water said ALREADY_DONE; a refusing skill needs the fallback a player would use (scoop from where you stand) or the planner loops between two refusals.
A retreat that starts with a monster 3-4 blocks away can't get away: the mob follows and hits our back. Fleeing only makes sense past melee range, or when we can wall in on the spot.

A reflex that checks only distance keeps restarting a fight the planner has already given up on (unreachable mark). The reflex's trigger should honour the same unreachable memory, with an exception for a mob that is really in reach.

When the planner's inventory test (Goal.have bucket counts filled buckets) says a step is ready but the skill's own check refuses, the skill must fix the state itself (pour out the spare water), or the planner offers the same refused step forever.

Creeper HAZARD failures happened because the attack quit as soon as it saw a lit fuse. The follow-up retreat then started 2-3 blocks from the creeper and failed with NO_PROGRESS, so backing off at once inside the attack should beat handing over to a new skill.

Repeated shore TIMEOUTs come from a 90 s pathed swim that doesn't move the bot. After one failure, swimming by hand on the surface toward seen land (or straight ahead), and switching targets when it stalls, should beat trying the same route again.
